reason: The rough edge can create the skin and vessel injury needed before clotting begins.
expectation: The body will acquire a small cut with a damaged blood vessel.

effect: The cut has exposed a bleeding vessel that is already narrowed; the next step is to limit the leak.
reaction: The narrowed vessel is a useful detail in the injury picture.
reason: Platelets at the cut are the clearest next component for forming an initial plug.
expectation: Platelets will gather at the damaged vessel and begin a plug.

effect: The platelet plug slows the leak; fibrin is the likely next step to reinforce it.
reaction: The distinction between slowing the leak and stabilizing the plug is useful.
reason: Activated clotting factors can convert soluble fibrinogen into clot-forming fibrin.
expectation: Fibrin will form and be available to reinforce the platelet plug.

effect: Clotting factors converted fibrinogen into threads that can reinforce the platelet plug.
reaction: The mesh makes the reinforcement step clear.
reason: Fibrin threads can mesh with the platelet plug to stabilize the clot.
expectation: The fibrin will reinforce the plug and stop the bleeding.

effect: The fibrin mesh stabilized the platelet plug and stopped the bleeding, while the skin remained open.
reaction: The distinction between sealing the vessel and healing the skin is useful.

mostWorthwhile.text: Reinforcing the platelet plug with fibrin was most worthwhile: the planned cutaway makes clear how the mesh stabilizes the plug without closing the skin.

leastWorthwhile.text: Creating fibrin threads felt somewhat repetitive because their planned picture already showed a mesh among platelets before the separate plug-reinforcement step.

surprise.text: The vessel was already narrowed immediately after the injury, before platelets were added; the picture showed this response without explaining it.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the activated clotting factors' role in converting fibrinogen could have been stated explicitly rather than left to the combination and picture.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the still-open skin repairs itself; stopping the bleeding leaves a meaningful next question.
